column1: # The party. Read by tools/xp.py, tools/combat.py and tools/hp.py.
# prime / score / bonus / next_level — experience.
#   `prime` is the class's prime requisite; a score of 16 or more earns +10% of
#   experience awarded (PHB p.9 fighters, p.10 magic-users, p.11 clerics and
#   thieves — all four verified from page renders).
#   `next_level` is the XP needed for 2nd level in that class.
# ac / hp_max — from the CURRENT STATE block of party_roster.md, which is where
#   the player states them. Tristle's AC 4 is leather (8) with his DEX 18
#   defensive adjustment of -4 (PHB p.11).
# melee_hit / melee_dmg — STRENGTH adjustments. They apply to melee and HURLED
#   weapons only, never to a bow: see rules/abilities.md. Dave's 18/26 is the
#   party's only one.
# missile_hit — DEXTERITY Reaction/Attacking adjustment (PHB p.11, DEXTERITY
#   TABLE I), which the book applies to "both surprise situations and missile
#   combat attacks". SEPARATE from any racial weapon bonus.
# proficient — weapons the character may use without the class non-proficiency
#   penalty from rules/combat.md. Anything not listed takes the penalty.
# bonus_weapons — weapons carrying an extra racial +1 to hit. Tristle is an elf,
#   which grants +1 with long sword, short sword and bow (PHB race description).
# TRISTLE'S SPEAR is NOT in his proficiencies and takes the thief's -3 every
#   time. That is intentional: a spear reaches from the SECOND RANK, and behind
#   Dave and Torsat in a 10-ft corridor a long sword reaches nothing. Do not
#   'correct' it. See CHECKLIST.md section 3.
